sentences.en: Tom had a second-hand car which was barely roadworthy.
sentences.zh: 汤姆有一辆二手车，这辆车勉强算得上适于公路行驶。

sentences.en: Before the trip, we need to check if our vehicle is roadworthy.
sentences.zh: 出行前我们需要检查车辆是否适于公路行驶。

sentences.en: The mechanic said that my car isn't yet roadworthy after the repairs.
sentences.zh: 修理工说我的车修理后还不适于上路行驶。

senses.zh: 适于行驶的；适合道路上使用的
